title: Skill 插件化 (同仓库 plugin) — 跟 EPIC-167 submodule 双层升级粒度
description:
EPIC-162 — 借鉴 https://github.com/huangruiteng/loopx skill 体系 (6 独立 skill 包 + install/status/uninstall CLI + activation gate + cross-host surface), 把 KALLAX 1 主 skill + 9 expert monolith 改造为可独立 install 的 plugin 架构.

**跟 EPIC-167 协同 (双层升级粒度)**:
- EPIC-162 = 同仓库 plugin 化 (拆 9 expert monolith → 独立 skill 包)
- EPIC-167 = 跨仓库 submodule 化 (kallax-experts 独立仓库 → submodule)
- 两者 1:1 互补, skill-manager.sh 同时管理 plugin + submodule

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-05 review loopx 后拍板 (P0, ROI 最高) — 当前 KALLAX `.claude/skills/kallax/` 是单一 skill, 9 expert (default/extended) 全部内嵌. 无法跨 host (Codex/Cursor/OpenCode), 无 install/uninstall CLI, 无 activation gate. 跟 loopx skill 体系对比见 confluence/decisions/loopx-vs-kallax-skill-gap-2026-08-05.md.

**设计 (跟 EPIC-160 install.sh Omnibus + EPIC-161 retrospective-routine + EPIC-167 submodule 1:1 pattern)**:
1. **独立 skill 包** — 把 9 expert 拆成独立 skill 包, 每个有 SKILL.md + agents/ + .kallax-skill-scope 8 字节标记 (跟 loopx `.loopx-skill-scope` 1:1)
2. **skill CLI** — `scripts/skill/skill-manager.sh` 提供 `install/status/uninstall/list/enabled/disable` 6 子命令 + EPIC-167 `submodule-init/update/status` 3 子命令
3. **activation gate** — 每个 skill 加 frontmatter `enabled_policy: true/false`, 运行时检查, 缺则 dry-run 提示
4. **cross-host surface** — `--surface codex/claude-code/opencode/cursor` 抽象层, skill 可适配 4 host
5. **install.sh 集成** — EPIC-160 Omnibus 加 skill scan/install 阶段 + EPIC-167 submodule install/update 阶段

**0 增 Rule, 0 改 source code 之外**: 跟 EPIC-160/EPIC-161/EPIC-167 1:1 pattern, 仅新 docs + scripts + skill 包拆分.

**跟 BE-14 关系**: 不冲突. 1 ticket 1 subagent 仍是 baseline.
**跟 EPIC-054-A 关系**: 不冲突. worktree 隔离仍 N ticket = N worktree.
**跟 EPIC-119 (OpenAI 3-Class tool taxonomy)**: skill install 是 action class, 不影响 orchestration/data 分类.
**跟 EPIC-167 关系**: 1:1 协同 (plugin + submodule 双层升级粒度).
acceptance: AC1: 9 expert 各拆成独立 skill 包, 路径 `.claude/skills/kallax-experts/<role>/SKILL.md`, 跟主 skill 解耦
AC2: 每个独立 skill 包有 `.kallax-skill-scope` 8 字节文件 (跟 loopx `.loopx-skill-scope` 1:1), 标记 skill scope
AC3: 每个独立 skill 包有 `agents/` 子目录 (跟 loopx `agents/` 1:1), 至少含 1 个 agent 角色 markdown
AC4: SKILL.md frontmatter 加 `enabled_policy: true/false` 字段, 运行时检查
AC5: `scripts/skill/skill-manager.sh` 提供 install/status/uninstall/list/enabled/disable 6 子命令, 退出码 0=PASS / 1=FAIL / 2=用户错误
AC6: `--surface codex/claude-code/opencode/cursor` 4 host 抽象, install 时生成对应 host 的 .md wrapper
AC7: `bash scripts/install.sh --update` 自动 scan + install 新 skill, 跟 EPIC-160 Omnibus 1:1 pattern
AC8: activation gate 5 步验证 (跟 loopx 1:1): resolve project → confirm todo → check boundary → architecture check → owner-gated
AC9: tests/integration/skill-plugin.test.sh ≥10 case PASS (install / status / uninstall / list / enabled / disable / cross-host / activation gate 5 步 / scope 标记 / 旧 monolith 向后兼容)
AC10: vitest sentinel tests PASS (build + sentinel)
AC12: 旧 `/kallax-expert` 路径向后兼容 (fallback 到 monolith skill)
AC13: docs/reference/skill-plugin-2026-08-05.md 加 skill-manager 用法 + activation gate 详解
AC14: CLAUDE.md 加 EPIC-162 引用 (跟 EPIC-160/EPIC-161 1:1 pattern)
AC15: 0 改 source code, 0 增 Rule
